source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: When you pick this unit to fight in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) or to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may Empower it by spending 1 [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). While it is Empowered, weapons its models are equipped with have **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** and **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**, except their blast pistols, dark lances and blasters.
